releaseNotes:
Security:
- Self-update now verifies the downloaded APK against the pinned release
  certificate (SHA-256, fail closed) before installing; first-party updates
  only, Shizuku download skips the pin.
- Expected signature is pinned at build time only — the runtime network
  fetch of SIGNATURE_URL is gone. AppConfig URLs derive from a single
  UpdateParser.REPO constant; github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com are
  repo-scoped, dot-segment traversal is resolved before matching.
- CI release pipeline now fails when the built APK's certificate does not
  match signature.txt (previously only printed).
- MainActivity no longer exported; predictive back enabled; shell command
  builders route package names through ShellSanitizer.

Locale:
- Portuguese removed, Indonesian added (full EN↔ID parity, ~1,158 entries,
  placeholders verified); locales_config is now en/id and wired via
  android:localeConfig. README Indonesian section replaces PT section.

Hygiene:
- Dead code removed (ML-Kit-era AppTranslator/LanguageSetup, boilerplate
  tests, duplicate keep-rules placeholder, network-fetched signature path).
- Overlay service coroutine scopes are shared and cancelled on destroy.
- Previously-silent catch blocks now log via logcat (Muimex11, WARN).
- Dark mode follows the system by default; EN/PT parity kept via tests.
- gs_launcher_colors.xml is committed so local builds work out of the box.
- Lint is tracked (continue-on-error) instead of || true; unit tests added
  for the automation token, Tasker parsing and repo-scoped update URLs.
